reviews.body: Thanks for the fix and the thorough cases! I pushed one small change to the new test: it no longer asserts that `other` has no `@keyframes`. Today `collect` drops keyframes that only non-critical rules use from both outputs, which is a separate bug, and that assertion would have locked it in. The check that unused keyframes stay out of the critical CSS is unchanged.
